//Urls: 5311 is Maba.VCT.InstructionAssistant; the VCT comm server uses 8765 for its WebSocket. Override with ASPNETCORE_URLS when hosting behind a reverse proxy.

CustomerPortal.//ProxyApiKey: Shared secret the front end must send in X-Portal-Api-Key. Empty disables the check - set it before the service is reachable from outside.
CustomerPortal.//TrustedProxies: Addresses of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For may be believed. Leave empty when nothing sits in front, or the per-caller limit can be bypassed.
